benefits.title: Why Foodly?
benefits.fast_text: About 30 minutes anywhere in the city on average.
benefits.quality_text: We work only with trusted kitchens and suppliers.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.maria_text: Super fast delivery, the food was hot and tasty! This is my third order already.
reviews.anastasia_text: Delivered in 25 minutes, the pizza was hot and the dough soft. I love that you can add a note to your order.
reviews.mykhailo_text: Easy-to-use menu and fair prices. The courier called ahead and brought everything in a thermal bag.
reviews.olena_text: Fresh rolls, rice not overcooked. Neat packaging, and chopsticks and sauces were included without asking.
reviews.serhii_text: The app runs smoothly and Apple Pay works. The burgers arrived with the buns intact.
reviews.viktoriia_text: I often order desserts, and they always arrive cold with the glaze intact. Thanks for the care!
reviews.artem_text: Ordered late at night and got it in 35 minutes. I liked seeing the order status in real time.
reviews.natalia_text: I love the “Combo” section. Better value for money than the competition, and the deals change often.
reviews.pavlo_text: Great support: they helped me change the address after I had ordered, and the courier adapted quickly.
reviews.kseniia_text: Handy that you can tip by card. The courier was polite and brought the order to my door despite the rain.
reviews.dmytro_text: Deliveries are never late and notifications arrive on time. Courier tracking helps me plan my time.

faq.a1: We deliver in thermal bags so your food arrives hot and safe.
faq.a2: About 30 minutes across the city on average. We show the exact time at checkout.
faq.q3: How can I pay for my order?
faq.a3: Pay by card online, with Apple Pay/Google Pay, or in cash to the courier.
faq.q4: Can I change or cancel my order?
faq.a4: Yes, contact support within 5 minutes of placing it and we will adjust your order.
